issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'עַד זְנוּנֵי אִיזֶבֶל אִמְּךָ וּכְשָׁפֶיהָ הָרַבִּים' literally means 'as long as the whoredoms of Jezebel your mother and her many sorceries [continue]'. The Vietnamese renders 'những điều gian ác và phù phép nhiều vô kể' ('wicked deeds and countless sorceries'), which omits the specific term 'whoredoms' (זְנוּנֵי) and replaces it with a generic 'wicked deeds' (gian ác), thereby losing the explicit sexual immorality connotation present in the Hebrew.
